title: Normal Skin
description: Well-balanced moisture and sebum, smooth texture, minimal imperfections.

title: Dry Skin
description: Feels tight, flaky patches, rough texture, less natural oil.

title: Oily Skin
description: Excess shine across the entire face, enlarged pores, prone to breakouts.

title: Combination Skin
description: Shiny T-Zone (forehead, nose, chin), dry or normal cheeks.

title: Sensitive Skin
description: Easily turns red, stings, or reacts poorly to new products.
